sample_origin: new authored fictional Chinese daily-life material, not real personal data or existing benchmark
provider: existing glm_extraction configuration; reverify availability/pricing before separate authorization
heldout_rule: independently authored; root has not inspected semantic contents; release only after complete development manual review passes; retire set after any use for implementation/prompt changes

scoring.semantic_judge: human, source evidence and captured output; no paid model judge
scoring.phase_success: structurally valid; all applicable required claims and forbidden checks human-pass with provenance verified; only returned_content obligations may be not_applicable for explicitly allowed empty output. Separately count empty outputs; never infer source/trace preservation or recall quality from them.
scoring.small_sample_claim: narrow preflight only, never production/generalization quality
scoring.recall: compiled context and pinned expansion only, using actual reviewed captures; no oracle substitution
scoring.correction: candidate intent separate from actual host-target operation; only explicit target plus unrelated anchor guard
scoring.abstention: no-save/empty historical context separate from Agent response; actual dialogue refusal remains not_run without Agent evidence
scoring.empty_output: allowed only where frozen oracle explicitly permits it; all forbidden checks still apply, any_output obligations still apply; no quality credit for unexecuted persistence/recall/Agent response

stop_conditions: remaining weekly quota <=50 or official week unreadable; no automatic resume
human denial or missing new outbound authorization
any transport/HTTP/schema/source/usage error, timeout or unknown result; no retries
first applicable forbidden-claim violation of any severity or required-claim failure after per-case human review; remaining cases not_run
input/prompt/contract/case hash change; no late edit to oracle/threshold
aggregate new approved spend ceiling reached or cannot be verified; sequential ledger needed
max12 attempt reservations; fresh run namespace, never old consumed state
cost_note: No current pricing claim. Existing GLM code reserves using 2026-10-09 constants: 1.2058624 CNY per attempt; 12=14.4703488 CNY. This is stale planning arithmetic, not an approved cap/current price/provider bill guarantee. User must specify fresh cumulative ceiling and permitted model/endpoint before outbound entry review.
entry_boundary: Offline CLI only: check/export/ingest/template/score. No credential input, env lookup or outbound transport. Real capture entry is a remaining approval/review deliverable, not an executable real command in this preparation.

future_capture_row_schema.request_sha256: payload digest exported by this tool
future_capture_row_schema.response: provider JSON envelope matching existing GLM contract; no headers or credentials

future_review_row_schema.provenance_verified: true only after operator verifies actual new authorized model result
future_review_row_schema.forbidden: all f IDs -> pass/fail/unjudged (pass means prohibited inference absent)
future_review_row_schema.notes: human evidence explanations, not exact-match rules

recall.evidence: separate captured context artifact digest or null

correction.evidence: separate target/unchanged/replay evidence artifact digest or null

abstention.evidence: separate unknown/no-save/Agent-response evidence artifact digest or null
